name: Fecto
tagline: Improve your website with your coding agent and pay for verified results.
description: Fecto is a website improvement workflow for founders and small businesses. Start with a free scan without creating an account, then use Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to implement changes you review. Fecto agrees a traffic or enquiry goal with the owner and measures it separately from the coding agent. Standard outcome tiers are +20% growth for $30, +50% for $60, and double for $100; below +20% is $0. Charges are capped at $100 per site per month. Fecto does not host websites, and separate agent and hosting costs still apply. Growth is not guaranteed.
